title: AN EMPIRICAL ANALYSIS OF FACTORS INSPIRING STUDENTS FOR ADMISSION IN DISTANCE EDUCATION PROGRAM AT BANGLADESH OPEN UNIVERSITY: A CASE STUDY
reason: Questionnaire survey of applicants on factors motivating admission to a distance MBA programme at Bangladesh Open University. Self-reported reasons only; no LMS or activity-product indicator and no learning-action outcome.

extraction.n_quote: structured questionnaire. The sample consisting of 325 respondents was drawn
extraction.population: applicants/aspiring students to a distance-education programme
extraction.notes: Respondents filled the questionnaire before the admission viva; arguably also E3-adjacent (applicants, not yet enrolled students).
